format_description: Best-of-3 with 7-point tiebreak at 6–6 in all sets.
Best-of-5 with tiebreak at 6–6 in all sets.
Final set uses 10-point super tiebreak at 6–6.
Final set is advantage set (no tiebreak).
Tiebreak played only at 12–12 in final set.
Fast4-style: sets to 4; tiebreak at 3–3; No-Ad.
Match tiebreak played in lieu of 3rd set (common in doubles).
